description: Angular component for a mobile app dialog, allowing creation or editing of mobile app configurations within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: MobileAppDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for the mobile app dialog, handling form initialization, validation, and save/cancel actions.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Initializes form fields after the view is loaded, setting default values and disabling the platformType field.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if a form control is in an error state, considering both default and custom validation states.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without saving changes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and submits the form data to save the mobile app configuration, then closes the dialog with the result.
